name: simplify
description: Reduce a mathematical expression to its simplest form. Input algebraic notation (e.g., "2^2+2(2)"). Returns simplified result.

name: derive
description: Find the derivative of an expression with respect to x. Input algebraic notation (e.g., "x^2"). Returns the derivative.

name: integrate
description: Find the indefinite integral of an expression with respect to x. Input algebraic notation (e.g., "x^2"). Returns antiderivative with constant C.

name: factor
description: Factor a polynomial into irreducible factors. Input polynomial (e.g., "x^2-1" or "x^2+3x+2"). Returns factored form.
